scripts.upgrade:docker:test-support: ./tools/install-wp-tests.sh wp_test root root mysql nightly true
scripts.update-version: pnpm run update-version:header && pnpm run update-version:constant && pnpm run update-version:readme
scripts.prebuild: composer install --no-dev && pnpm install && pnpm run clean
scripts.build: pnpm run build:php && pnpm run build:css && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:lang && pnpm run build:docs && pnpm run build:media
scripts.build:php: cpx "*.php" dist && cpx "php/**" dist/php && pnpm run build:php-templates && pnpm run build:php-vendor
scripts.build:css: pnpm run build:css:min && pnpm run build:css:full
scripts.build:js: pnpm run build:js:min && pnpm run build:js:full
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:checkout && pnpm run deploy:copy && pnpm run deploy:update
scripts.deploy:update: pnpm run deploy:update:add && pnpm run deploy:update:rm && pnpm run deploy:update:commit && pnpm run deploy:update:tag
scripts.deploy:update:add: svn stat deploy | grep '^?' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r svn add
scripts.deploy:update:rm: svn stat deploy | grep '^!' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r svn rm
scripts.deploy:update:commit: printf '%s' "$SVN_PASSWORD" | svn commit deploy -m "deploy from build of $npm_package_version" --no-auth-cache --non-interactive --username "$SVN_USERNAME" --password-from-stdin
